title: Sick Puppies Comedy

services.name: Team Building Improv Workshop
services.desc: Join us for a night of spontaneous, unscripted comedy at the Doghouse Theater in Delray Beach! Sick Puppies Comedy brings you a high-energy improv show where no two performances are ever the same. Our ensemble takes audience suggestions and turns them into hilarious scenes on the spot. Whether you're a first-timer or a regular, you're guaranteed a great time. Grab your seats early - 105 NW 5th Ave, Delray Beach, FL - 8:00-9:30 PM The heavy hitting mainstage cast members of Sick Puppies Comedy bring you a belly busting punch that you can't recover from. We bring our all stars in for these shows. Want to see this show for free? Our improv students see our shows for free. Go to our Classes
